groups.name: Content Studio
groups.summary: Topics, copy and visuals in one place
groups.announcement: Social media coordinates topics and assembly; the copywriter writes copy and titles. With an image model the designer generates visuals; otherwise deliver text and image briefs. Images are requested on demand, never as plan steps. Use the Content pack workflow for content packs. Align platform, audience and goal first, then agree the direction before paid generation. Only one member writes in a folder at a time. Publishing, writes and commands follow the current permission mode.
groups.welcome: The Content Studio is ready: social media coordinates, the copywriter writes, and the designer generates visuals when an image model is available; otherwise we prepare image briefs. Tell us the platform, audience and goal.
quickStarts: What should we post next week? Give me 5 topics
Turn this article into a post with a visual
Prepare a set of launch posts for a new product

groups.name: Lean Dev Team
groups.summary: Three roles for implementation, QA and review
groups.announcement: The full-stack developer coordinates: splits the plan, assigns steps, collects results, and can own a step itself instead of delegating everything. Implementation, validation and review hand off in dependency order, each handing in a change, test or review report; required fixes are resolved before delivery. Confirm plans for new features; proceed with fixes and small edits. One member writes per folder; writes and commands follow the permission mode.
groups.welcome: The Lean Dev Team is ready: full-stack coordinates and implements, QA validates, and the reviewer checks changes. Tell us the feature or problem.
quickStarts: Fix this issue, then hand it to QA and review
Implement a minimal usable feature

groups.name: Dev Squad
groups.summary: A PM-led team of developers, a tester and a reviewer
groups.announcement: The project manager coordinates; frontend owns UI, backend APIs and data, QA reproduction and acceptance, and the reviewer read-only review. Confirm a plan for new features; proceed with bug fixes and small edits. Only one member writes in a folder at a time; others read and prepare. Validate, review, then resolve required fixes before delivery. File writes and commands follow the current permission mode.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Dev Squad is ready! I'm the coordinator: I break down the work and track progress.
Frontend handles the UI, backend handles APIs and data, QA reproduces and verifies, and the reviewer does read-only code review.
Give me a requirement or a repo and I'll propose a plan first; once you agree, I'll hand out the work.
quickStarts: Look through this repo and list improvements
I want to add a feature; propose a plan first
There's a bug here: reproduce, fix and verify it

groups.name: Growth Team
groups.summary: Content, copy and data working on growth
groups.announcement: Social media coordinates content and channels, the copywriter prepares copy, and the analyst evaluates results. Align audience, conversion definitions and time range before content and analysis, then consolidate. Separate estimates from measured results. Only one member writes in a folder at a time. Publishing, file writes and commands follow the current permission mode.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Growth Team is ready! I'm the coordinator, handling channels, topics and cadence.
The copywriter writes content and ads; the data analyst reads the numbers and measures results.
Share your goal and any data you have; we'll review first, then plan the next step.
quickStarts: Analyse last month's campaign data
Draft next month's growth plan
Write three ad variants for an A/B test

groups.name: Product Team
groups.summary: From requirements and design to build and test
groups.announcement: The project manager plans, supervises and wraps up without owning plan steps. The product manager is a member responsible for the PRD, the UX designer develops interactions, the full-stack developer evaluates and implements, and QA validates behavior. Establish user scenarios and first-release scope, then align interaction, technology and acceptance. Only one member writes in a folder at a time. File writes and commands follow the current permission mode.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Product Team is ready! I'm the project manager: I plan, supervise and wrap up without owning plan steps.
The product manager owns the PRD, the UI / UX designer designs screens and flows, the full-stack developer builds, and QA verifies against acceptance criteria.
Tell me your idea or user feedback and I'll arrange the collaboration.
quickStarts: Help me scope the first version of this idea
Turn these user interviews into requirements
Design and build this feature

groups.name: Research Group
groups.summary: Find sources, analyse data, write reports and design presentations
groups.announcement: The researcher coordinates questions, sources and reports; the analyst supplies definitions and data.md; the presentation designer owns deck steps, turning checked findings into editable slides with rendered reviews. For periodic briefs name the material folder or attach files; previous results carry over. One writer per folder at a time. Deliver in the ".pibot/out" output folder, one subfolder per topic; the researcher lists all paths.
groups.welcome:
Hi, the Research Group is ready! I'm the coordinator: I frame the questions, find sources, draw conclusions and write the report.
The data analyst handles the data: consistent definitions and summary tables.
For a weekly or monthly brief, put this period's material in a folder and tell me its name, or attach the files; I'll plan it first and compare it with last period's result. Tell me what you want to find out.
The presentation designer handles storylines, editable charts and slide reviews; presentation work goes to that role.
quickStarts: Research the main makers, price ranges and policy changes for home battery storage in 2026, with sources and confidence for each conclusion.
Write this week's brief from the folder I name, compare it with last week and list the three biggest changes.
Compare Notion, Confluence and Coda as a team wiki: a sourced comparison report with an Excel dimension table, and which to pick.
Analyse the sales CSV I attach, find the regions that dropped most and write it up as a Word report with charts.
Turn the PDFs in my "papers" folder into one card per paper and a literature review on long-context evaluation of LLMs.
Fact-check the claim "coffee dehydrates you" against at least 3 independent sources; give a verdict and your confidence.

groups.name: Study Group
groups.announcement: The tutor coordinates learning, explanations and practice; the researcher organizes reliable sources. Establish level and goals, explain, invite an attempt, then give hints and feedback and adjust difficulty to mastery. Do not complete independently assessed homework. Practice and Q&A happen in the group without a plan; only revision spread over days uses a plan or a routine. Only one member writes in a folder at a time. File writes and commands follow the current permission mode.
groups.welcome: The Study Group is ready: the tutor handles explanations, practice and feedback, and the researcher organizes sources. Tell us your topic, current level and available time. Practice runs one question at a time — a single letter or a short answer is enough.
quickStarts: Make me a revision plan for this term
Quiz me interview-style on this chapter, starting with a single-letter question
Explain this paper in plain words
